title: Meals You Can't Miss
editorial: Brazil is meat-eater heaven. Brazilian barbecue is among the best in the world and the national dish, feijoada, is a mandatory meal! In Rio de Janeiro, our favourite spot for feijoada was the austere Brasileiro de Copa.
Brazil has the biggest Japanese community outside of Japan. Meng in Rio and Hira Ramen Izakaya in Sao Paulo were solid ramen shops.

The Amazonas region has delectable river fish (which tends to be bonier than sea fish). Tambaqui de Banda in Manaus is a fabulous spot with live music and dance. And to our surprise, acai originates in this part of the world and isn’t yet another East Asian export!
